Review is still blocked by two concrete composition defects. Preserve this existing plan's accepted requirements, public inputs/results, operations, cookie handling, actual search submission, bounded page/product loops, workbook writers/branches and root cleanup. Do not remove requested work. Make only the following implementation corrections (structural replacement of the four redundant view transforms is explicitly requested).
1. require_home_page_complete, require_ready_page_complete, require_search_page_complete and require_product_page_complete wrongly require nextCursor=null on every manifest page. The authoritative paged snapshot deliberately returns continuation on intermediate pages. The existing foreach consumes every manifest descriptor before navigation, so require captureTruncated=false on each page, keep both original manifest truncation checks, and preserve the full bounded foreach. Do not require intermediate pages to have no nextCursor or truncated=false. Do not remove the manifest guards or shorten the iteration. You may also check each page's snapshot id against its owning manifest and its returned record count against its descriptor when binding those exact authoritative fields; never guess completeness from a model.
2. Replace home_page_controls_view, ready_page_controls_view, search_page_business_view and product_page_business_view learned whole-array extract transforms with ordinary nested foreach over the authoritative records, maxItems=200, no inference in the record body, and explicit typed field/object exports. Copy EVERY original record in order, preserving duplicate records and grouping, with consumer-specific fields. No semantic filtering, new classification, defaults, invented fields or mapping scripts. Update only affected exports and input references consistently through their enclosing scopes.
For home/ready control interpretation, pass kind, text, role, group and selector because the chosen control's exact selector is needed; do not include href. For the search-status interpreter, pass kind, text and group only. For product selection, create a separate view with kind, text, group and href; the subsequent action navigates by URL, so selectors and generated ordinal fields are unnecessary. Product selection should return only observed title and URL plus its status, and the product loop must still visit that exact URL. For product status/extraction, pass kind, text and group plus the explicit current product URL/context; do not include selectors or href arrays. Keep full authoritative observations and exact action references in the original producer bindings. A consumer must not receive a superset containing the other consumer's view or the raw collection again.
Use direct typed exports for these copies. Retain explicit global interpretations for business decisions/extraction and the final at-most-three-row workbook formatting; do not introduce per-record or per-page LLM calls. Keep every required fact and original manifest completeness check. Preserve exact workbook writer outputs rather than substituting a literal path. No additional discovery should be needed: all relevant contracts are already inspected.
